basis: Line coverage of every shipped source family, measured by `coverage run` with the `population` flags: the whole tree counts (src/, the public root ghwidgets_data.py and scripts/) and only tests/ is left out, because the tests are the instrument, not the subject. It is measured on the one CI cell `cell` names, because a percentage is comparable only within one interpreter build. `floor` is what the gate enforces. `coverage_ratchet.py raise` moves it up only when a measurement beats `measured` by more than the 1.5-point hysteresis, and then sets it to that measurement minus the fixed 1.5-point gap; no automated path lowers it. `measured`, `statements` and `missing` are the measurement that last raised or re-derived the record, and `measured_commit` and `measured_at` say where and when it was taken. Both gate and raise refuse a measurement over a different `files` count, until a person re-derives this record for the new population.
